name: Huchuy Qosqo trek
region: Hills between Cusco and the Sacred Valley
why: Over the puna above Cusco on old Inca paths to 'Little Cusco', a royal estate with adobe halls on a terrace high above the Sacred Valley, then down a long stair to Lamay.
book: No public road reaches the ruins: you walk or ride. Entry is paid on site to the two caretakers (about S/22, students S/10, cash). Taxi from Cusco to Tambomachay; colectivo from Lamay back to Cusco via Pisac. Tours with mules and camp gear are sold in Cusco.
water: Few streams on the puna and they run past grazing animals: treat the water or carry 2 litres per day.
dangers: The passes are above 4,200 m: spend two or three days in Cusco first.
Cold nights below freezing in the dry season, sun burns by day.
The 1,000 m descent to Lamay is steep and hard on the knees.
turnaround: Not over the high pass by 13:00, or fog on the puna: go back to Tambomachay, the paths there split and are easy to lose.

points.name: Tambomachay
points.note: The Inca fountains on the road above Cusco, 3,750 m. The path climbs north past the village onto the open puna.

points.name: Huchuy Qosqo ruins
points.note: 3,650 m: Inca halls with adobe walls, terraces and a long kallanka, 1,000 m above the Urubamba. Camp by the caretakers' house.

points.name: Lamay
points.note: 2,920 m, on the Sacred Valley road after a steep descent of about two hours. Colectivos to Pisac and Cusco from the plaza.
